original_outcomes.rationale: Original 2.516B final post-trained RL/OPD compact general LLM, 131072 context. Independent learned result rather than the GGUF/MLX conversions of same model; Base and SFT are distinct earlier stages and are held rather than duplicated.
original_outcomes.quality_producer_claim: First-party Apache-2.0 11-file 5.044GB original, 42-layer LlamaForCausalLM. Publisher score average53.9 in its stated test set, next comparison model 51.1; qualitative gains code/math/agents, not independently reproduced.
original_outcomes.limitations: Author-selected benchmark/cost methodology lacks owner matched baselines; long-context KV/memory/latency untested on user device. Storing Base/SFT would add extra ~5GB per earlier trained stage without proven research utility.

original_outcomes.rationale: Separate full 0.853B Qwen3.5-0.8B finetune trained by probability distillation from IVE-4B with its own 255-choice readout, not a quantization of 4B. Preserving a uniquely small OCR-free decision model.
original_outcomes.quality_producer_claim: 21 files 1.728GB including standalone BF16 backbone plus separate FP32 readout.safetensors. Publisher vision Decision Index 47.6 (#2 of 10 <=1B) and calibration ECE 2.3% (4th of 73 <1B). Its training Qwen0.8B parent exact SHA matches the reported-acquired 116 ledger.
original_outcomes.limitations: Author private visual vision 39.5 vs Valen39.7, text results middling (text #14 of 73); no evaluation in Japanese and no independent owner run. Needs audited package source/, transformers>=5.7,<6, flash-linear-attention0.5.2 CUDA runtime.

original_outcomes.rationale: Original full finetune of Qwen3.5-4B, trained teacher decision model to Ivonnet; learned 255-choice FP32 readout with OCR-free image documents and probability decisions, not same trained weights as 0.8B student.
original_outcomes.quality_producer_claim: 23 files /9.103GB with 2 BF16 source weight shards and standalone readout. Author ranks #1 in new-domain private Decision Index tasks among 166 models <=5B and reports vision index65.5 / calibration ECE1.6%, 21 Nov 2026 benchmark edition.
original_outcomes.limitations: Provenance of public/private Decision Index methodology not owner replicated. 0.8B student covers a subset at lower capacity; no user-device calibrated quality, image latency, memory or code supply chain test. Publisher RTX PRO 6000 vs owner HW not equivalent.

original_outcomes.rationale: Distinct Qwen3.5-0.8B family ecommerce finetune for image/multi-image/video/OCR and hybrid reasoning, not the same trained state as Ivonnet. One original BF16 model chosen; FP8/GPTQ/GGUF are representation variants.
original_outcomes.quality_producer_claim: 20 files/1.733GB, Apache2 ungated. Publisher reports +16.43 point e-commerce average and +6.93 general mean against Qwen3.5-0.8B across author-selected 28 e-commerce and 64 general tasks; no external replication.
original_outcomes.limitations: Business-domain benchmarks and moderation tasks not independent evidence of general reasoning improvement. Transformers>=5.2, TorchCodec/FFmpeg compatibility for video, owner license/copyright and live GPU quality are not checked.
